## Workload

Marcus Bell completed 813 reads during the review period, working 456 hours. This represents an average of 1.8 reads per hour. The workload was recorded against the expected session pattern and provides the basis for the quality review.

## Quality

A total of 69 reads were checked again. Agreement between the grader and reviewer was 59.4 per cent. The current session pattern will be retained, with the results noted for ongoing monitoring.
